title: The What and When of Longevity Dieting - Nautilus
gist: A review in Innovation Nutrition drawing on 30+ longitudinal studies and meta-analyses proposes an age-specific precision-nutrition longevity diet tuning macronutrient proportions and sources to mimic calorie restriction's benefits without its drawbacks.

insights.claim: Calorie restriction extends lifespan in lab animals but is impractical for humans, who don't enjoy starving themselves.
insights.so_what: Adherence problems limit calorie-restriction-based longevity products.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie

insights.claim: A review in Innovation Nutrition, drawing on more than 30 longitudinal studies and meta-analyses, proposes a longevity diet based on precision nutrition with different recommendations for different ages, tuning proportions and sources of protein, carbohydrates, fat and fiber.
insights.so_what: Supports the precision-nutrition and personalized-longevity market.
insights.quote: a longevity diet based on precision nutrition, with different recommendations for different ages
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
